violation_type.title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - Driver or designated employee verify all children accounted for (26 TAC §746.5625(d)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - Driver or designated employee verify all children accounted for
violation_type.typical_finding: Vehicle is designated to transport eight person and it does not have an electronic child safety alarm system.

finding_variants.text: Vehicle is designated to transport eight person and it does not have an electronic child safety alarm system.
Based on the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to suggest that the driver of the vehicle did not ensure that all children had been accounted for.
A six-year-old child was left sleeping in the center van when a caregiver failed to thoroughly conduct a visual check of the vehicle.
The bus driver did not ensure and verify all children were accounted for when dropping off the children at school and as result a child was left on the bus.
The child safety alarm in the van is located in the front and not the rear as required per minimum standards.
The child safety alarm remains in need of repair in order to provide automatic activation when the van ignition is turned on.
